Subject: Internal — suggested invoice templates and math notes

Quick internal note after looking at Acme projection: 
- For the numbers they shared, marginal billing produces a lower bill in early months and slightly higher at peak months compared with blended. Example (monthly tokens = 120M):
  * Brackets: 0-10M @ $0.015, 10-100M @ $0.010, 100M+ @ $0.0075 (marginal rates)
  * If month usage = 120M: marginal cost = (10M*$0.015) + (90M*$0.010) + (20M*$0.0075) = $150k + $900k + $150k = $1.2M -> effective = $0.01/token
  * Blended offer (single effective rate) at same month might be $0.0095/token -> $1.14M total (slightly lower due to negotiated blended discount).
- Recommendation: Offer them both visuals but propose blended effective-rate invoicing as the default for 6- or 12-month pilots (simpler for Acme AP), with an explicit clause that reserves the right to convert to marginal invoicing on annual renewals.
- Accounting/contract ask: if blended is chosen, include a table showing quarterly true-up math and sample invoice lines: gross usage, credits/committed discounts, true-up charge, net charge.

I'll draft a compact invoice template and SOW paragraph for blended vs marginal. Laura — can you confirm if Legal is comfortable with the quarterly true-up mechanic? Marcus — can you add a short note on how caching/prefix savings could be shown as a reporting line (non-billable) on the invoice?

-Ben
Director, Sales Strategy

Laurel / Tom — thanks for the prompt. A few clarifications and proposals inline: 

1) Invoice format: we can provide either: 
   - Option A (Blended/effective rate): single per-token line, plus a supplemental appendix showing bracket math for transparency. Net charge = effective_rate * total_tokens.
   - Option B (Marginal): multiple line items per bracket with units and per-token rate for each bracket.

2) Sample numbers (from attached model):
   - Month 6 projection = 95M tokens -> marginal = $ (10M*$0.015) + (85M*$0.010) = $150k + $850k = $1.0M -> effective = $0.010526/token.
   - If we negotiated a blended lock for pilot at $0.00975/token the same month invoiced = $926k (credit applied up front as monthly discount).

3) True-up & timing: we can do monthly usage reporting + monthly invoice with a quarterly true-up settlement for any band overages. Alternatively, we can do calendar-month invoices with a single quarterly reconciliation document. Both are fine; you indicated AP prefers calendar-month single invoice — we can output that.

4) Contract language: propose a sentence for SOW: "For the pilot period the parties agree to a blended invoicing option as set forth in Exhibit A. Quarterly reconciliations will be performed to true-up usage above committed bands; overages will be invoiced at marginal bracket rates unless otherwise agreed in renewal."

- Ben will attach a compact invoice template and a one-page SOW paragraph by end of week.
- Laurel — once you confirm AP cadence and whether you want blended default, we'll pick the default in the SOW and run a short 20-min walkthrough of the invoice model.
